notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
